about_the_game:
Joyful Masks is a 3D first-person psychological puzzle game with atmospheric horror elements, crafted in Unreal Engine 5. Navigate through evolving, self-contained levels that challenge your perception with intricate puzzles, shifting environments, and a haunting story-driven experience.

In a bold experiment, Professor Saggi undergoes a deep, drug-induced coma, allowing his assistant, Kurt, to enter his subconscious through an advanced neuro-interactive system. What begins as a controlled study quickly spirals into a surreal descent through a fractured mind. Familiar university halls transform into something living, shadows move on their own, and buried traumas come to life.

With no combat or jump scares, Joyful Masks builds tension through discovery, immersion, and the quiet unease of a world where reality is ever-shifting. Each puzzle solved peels back another layer of Professor Saggi’s past—until you reach a truth too hard to ignore.

Inspired by the rich atmospheres of historic Italian architecture and the lush countryside, Joyful Masks invites you into a world that feels lived-in yet touched by something just out of reach. Cozy sunlit spaces, overgrown courtyards, and strange dreamlike distortions create a journey that’s both comforting and unsettling.

Key Features

  • Intricate first-person puzzle-solving with evolving, self-contained levels

  • Atmospheric exploration blending cozy familiarity with unsettling distortions

  • A deeply personal, psychological story set in a fractured mind

  • Rich Italian-inspired environments filled with history and quiet mystery

  • No combat or jump scares—tension builds through immersion and discovery

Can you untangle the layers of memory and subconscious thought to uncover the truth—or will you become lost in the mind’s labyrinth?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains suicide as a topic or theme

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3100 or Intel Core i3-9100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5500 or Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 7700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Step into the subconscious mind of a brilliant professor, where memories twist, logic bends, and hidden truths await discovery through intricate puzzles
